questions.direction_text: The following questions are accompanied by two statements (I) and (II). You have to determine which statements(s) is/are sufficient/necessary to answer the questions.
questions.stem:
A seller marked up the price of an article 50% above cost price and give two successive discounts. Find the aggregate percentage of discount.
I. Seller make the Aggregate profit of 14.75%
II. M.R.P. of the Article is Rs. 750 and it sold in Rs. 73.75 more than the cost price.

options.a: Statement (I) alone is sufficient to answer the question but statement (II) alone is not sufficient to answer the questions
options.b: Statement (II) alone is sufficient to answer the question but statement (I) alone is not sufficient to answer the question
options.c: Both the statements taken together are necessary to answer the questions, but neither of the statements alone is sufficient to answer the question
options.d: Either statement (I) or statement (II) by itself is sufficient to answer the question
options.e: Statements (I) and (II) taken together are not sufficient to answer the question
